The '''corrosion slug''' was a [[Slug/Legends|slug]] existing in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] once had an encounter with corrosion slugs, prior to encountering the [[Serpent Masters]] of [[Ophideraan]], which left him upset over slithering, squirming things.<ref name="The Serpent Masters" />
